annotations.title: Find Argentine places in a city

description: Argentine businesses in a city abroad: parrillas and restaurants, cafés, bakeries (medialunas, facturas), grocery stores (almacén), bars, ice cream shops and cultural centres, nearest to the city centre first, with address, whether they are open now, phone, website, Instagram and the Argento page of each place. Filter by type, by a word in the name or address, or open now. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

city.description: The city: its slug from list_cities (madrid, new-york…), its name in Spanish, English or Italian (Madrid, New York, London, Londra…) or one of its airport codes (MAD, JFK).

lang.description: Language of the labels and of the text summary: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

open_now.description: Only the places open right now.

query.description: Word to look for in the name or address (accents not needed).

type.description: restaurant (parrilla, empanadas…), cafe, bakery (panadería), food_shop (almacén, Argentine grocery), bar, cultural_center, ice_cream (heladería).

name: find_argentine_places
title: Find Argentine places in a city
